annotations.text:
Read left to right, top row first.

Everything is lifted from the shipped design system — Geist, the oklch tokens resolved to hex, the Page/PageHeader/Card rhythm, 8px control radii, 14px card radii. Nothing here invents a second visual language.

The usage strip sits above the list rather than in Settings.

These free tiers are finite enough that people will reach them, and a limit somebody only meets by hitting it reads as a bug.

The inspector is the differentiator.

Comparable products hide chunking. Showing the passages — with their heading path, page and approximate token count — means that when an answer is wrong later, the cause is inspectable rather than a matter of trust. Overlap is shown rather than hidden, because it looks like a bug until it is explained.
